column1: # close_standing_checks.tsv — THE STANDING CLOSE-CHECK SET every close inherits (GitHub #204; claim generation #207).
# Rendered for one close by `python3 tools/close_standing.py render --key 14z-N --row "(N) THE FINDINGS TABLE"
# --run build/agentNNN/close`, which writes <run>/checks.tsv (the three columns tools/close_checks.py runs) and
# <run>/checks_decl.tsv (what each check sees and does not, read by `close_standing.py claim`). A close ADDS only
# what is new to it (`render --extra FILE`, rows in this same six-column form); nothing below is edited per close.
# PLACEHOLDERS — the only parameters, and everything else is DERIVED:
#   {KEY}        the session key, given                   {ROW}   the findings row's title, given
#   {RUN}        the close's run directory, given          {SESSDIR}  its parent (the session's scratch dir)
#   {BASE}       the last commit before the first `{KEY}:` commit (derived from git by render)
#   {TRANSCRIPT} the session transcript (render: the newest top-level .jsonl of the project; --transcript overrides)
# Per-session DATA (never lists typed here) lives in the run directory: {RUN}/classes.tsv (scratch census),
# findings row handed to the rule-checker, written by `close_standing.py row-copy --write`).
# PLANTS are GENERATED at run time from the live inputs (`close_standing.py plant`, exit 3 if it cannot build one), so
# a plant never goes stale against the file it perturbs; each must make its check exit EXACTLY the expected non-zero.
# Columns (tab-separated): name, expected exit, WHAT it sees, NOT SEEN, figure (a regex: the first output line it
# matches is quoted in the generated claim; `-` for none), command.

column3: lists the addresses the {KEY} group names that no live document carries (GAPS) or only text older than the session carries (REVIEW), and the group's PROMISES
column4: it exits 0 whatever the lists hold, so each GAP and REVIEW is answered by hand; a finding with no address

the reason check fails on a generated copy of STATE.md whose findings row gains a bare `none`
column6: python3 tools/close_standing.py plant bare-none --row "{ROW}" --out {RUN}/plants && python3 tools/none_reasons.py --row "{ROW}" {RUN}/plants/STATE_plant.md
